content.short: TraitWars is a Top trumps style NFT battle game.
content.description: Trait Wars isn't just a game; it's a dynamic, ever-evolving product where your strategic decisions and the traits of your NFTs determine your path to victory. We aim to create a vibrant community where players can connect, compete, and collaborate, all while enjoying the thrill of collecting and battling with their favorite NFTs. Engage in battles where your strategic choices and understanding of your NFTs' traits will determine your success. Will you be able to rise to the top of the leaderboard.
